item.title: v1.3.0 - fancy new corrections, points, and stats 📈
item.description:
Copy of an email update from mailing list: weirdfriends

Hello gang,

I spent my 2 days off basically just coding. The wife isn’t the happiest about it, but:

WE’VE GOT SOME COOL NEW THINGS! 🤩

Fancy New Corrections & Points 🔧

  • I changed up the agent architecture and now have a dedicated (and fancier 💅) model/prompt for better corrections of your messages.
  • There’s now a grammarly-inspired UI where it highlights issues in your messages and you can click on them to learn more!
  • Also, you will get points for perfect messages in a language! 💯

item.title: congrats on failing to launch; weirdfriends log 1
item.description: 7 months, 221 commits, and I still haven’t told anyone to try my app. A reflection on what went wrong.
